; Selection tool: drop the text-select gesture on PDF pages, so a stroke always lassoes.
AFFECT [[11806562588218124596]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]] > [[17327575798530333160]]#[[11510301049521437407]]
        REBUILD [[482731727916584909]]
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            REPLACE { ~&7083121450889&~ ~&17327575798530333160&~.~&3230372125241945261&~ } WITH { ~&7083121450889&~ (~&7082020628281&~.rmhNoPdfTextSelectionHack && ~&6504254477&~.~&16188953640777021966&~ ? 0 : ~&17327575798530333160&~.~&3230372125241945261&~) }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
